claims.text: Metastatic or locally advanced BCC not suited to surgery or radiation: vismodegib or sonidegib (Hedgehog pathway inhibitors); cemiplimab (PD-1) if those aren't tolerated
claims.quote: If patients have metastatic or locally advanced disease and are not candidates for surgery or radiation therapy (eg, because lesions are large, recurrent, or metastatic), vismodegib or sonidegib may be given (4, 5). Both medications inhibit the Hedgehog pathway. Cemiplimab, a programmed death-receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitor, is an option for patients who cannot tolerate Hedgehog pathway inhibitors (6).
